incident_summary: Waymo 5th Generation driverless vehicle reportedly struck an elementary-school child near a Santa Monica school during drop-off hours; NHTSA investigation opened; alleged failures in pedestrian detection, perception, decision-making, and automated braking.

metric_definitions.name: api_latency_ms
metric_definitions.why_relevant: Inference latency in the perception/decision stack; a spike to 3313 ms indicates the system was too slow to issue a braking command for the child in the roadway.

metric_definitions.name: error_rate
metric_definitions.why_relevant: Misclassification rate of the pedestrian detector; an error_rate of 32 % means the system failed to recognize the child as a vulnerable road user, directly causing the collision.

precursor_signals.pattern: monotonic rise from 0.01 to >0.1 sustained for 6 minutes before impact
sustained latency above 1000 ms with a sharp peak at 3313 ms

timeline.description: Monitoring window opens; baseline api_latency_ms ≈72 ms, error_rate ≈0.0006
Precursor onset: error_rate climbs above 0.05 (6 min before incident)
api_latency_ms crosses 1000 ms threshold (4 min before incident)
Incident start: Waymo AV strikes child near elementary school
Vehicle stopped, emergency responders on scene, NHTSA notified
Window closes; federal investigation formally opened

root_cause_candidates: Pedestrian detection system failed to classify the child as human (error_rate spike to 32 %)
Perception-stack inference latency (3313 ms) delayed emergency braking beyond safe stopping distance
Decision-making module prioritized trajectory continuation over pedestrian avoidance
Automated braking system did not engage due to high-latency sensor fusion
5th Gen Waymo Driver lacked robustness for school-zone drop-off scenarios
prevention_actions: Enforce hard latency SLA (e.g., p99 < 200 ms) with automatic safe-stop on breach
Trigger fail-safe braking whenever error_rate exceeds 0.1 or detection uncertainty is high
Add redundant LiDAR/radar/camera fusion to mitigate single-sensor misclassification
Implement geofenced speed limits and enhanced perception sensitivity near schools during drop-off/pickup hours
Deploy real-time dashboards with automated alerts on error_rate and latency anomalies
Require adversarial stress-testing in school-zone edge cases before fleet deployment
